Import a map

A Universal VTT file (.dd2vtt from Dungeondraft, or .uvtt: its picture, grid, walls, doors and lights) or a picture alone (PNG, JPEG, WebP: you set its grid). Next you check the squares: walls are whole squares (the map rule). The map stays on this PC; its licence is yours to respect (most map packs allow personal use only, and an adventure for sale needs the artist's commercial licence).

Who sees whom

Each character sees the ticked creatures; each player's screen shows only what their character sees. Ticked from the engine's sight now (light, darkvision, blindness, walls: a creature that sheds light is seen in the dark). A box you change holds until the engine's own answer changes (a creature moves, a light goes out); then the engine decides again. A gold box differs from the engine.
